source_column_6: Purpose

source_column_2: 6061-T6 aluminium tube and sheet for the team-made chassis; profiles, wall thickness and cut lengths from approved fabrication drawings
source_column_6: Stock allowance including offcuts, not installed mass. Selected layout: four-wheel skid-steer. Verify the complete rover against the team’s 9 kg target and the 76.2 cm ready-to-run cube.

source_column_2: Suspension fabrication and fastening kit: arms, fixed-steering uprights, pivot shafts/shoulder bolts, bushes, spacers, travel stops, locking nuts, washers and retainers
source_column_6: Replaces the unspecified differential-linkage kit. Wheel carriers must resist steering rotation. Release geometry, fastener grades and quantities from CAD and load checks. Budget allowance.

source_column_2: Suspension pivot bearing/bushing kit; 608ZZ bearings are 8 × 22 × 7 mm and may be used only on matching 8 mm journals
source_column_6: Pivot-bearing allowance; exact type and count depend on the drawing. These bearings are not a direct fit on the 6 mm motor shafts. Wheel-support bearings are in the next dedicated kit.

source_column_2: Matched spring-and-damper assemblies, including springs and end mounts; rate, eye-to-eye length and stroke selected from full-payload corner loads and suspension geometry
source_column_6: Four complete units, one per wheel, each including a spring. Budget BDT 800 each. Match rate, installed length, stroke and mounting to full-payload CAD. The four additional standalone springs are listed separately.

source_column_2: Additional standalone suspension springs with seats/retainers; rate, free length, preload and travel matched to their separate CAD mounting locations
source_column_6: Four additional springs in the user-stated eight-unit suspension. Budget allowance BDT 200 each. Complete spring/damper units already contain springs; buy these extras only if separately required by the CAD and combined spring-rate calculation.

source_column_2: Bearing-supported wheel spindle/carrier assemblies: two bearing positions per wheel, matched stub axles, wheel attachment flanges, spacers and positive retention
source_column_6: Carries terrain impact and side loads separately from the gearbox output bearings. Added fabrication allowance; select shaft sizes, bearing loads and offsets from the final CAD. Motor couplings are separate.

source_column_2: Clamping shaft couplings: 6 mm motor-side bore matched to the actual shaft profile; wheel-side bore matched to the supported spindle; screws and positive retention
source_column_6: Transfers motor torque to the supported wheel spindles. Revised coupling allowance replaces direct motor-shaft wheel hubs; verify alignment and clearance throughout suspension travel.

source_column_2: 12 V brushed metal gearmotor, approximately 200 RPM, 6 mm output shaft; Model 2343 retained only as a provisional candidate
source_column_6: Four installed, two spares; BDT 1,350 each retained as an estimate. Before purchase, obtain rated torque/current, stall current and gearbox limits, then verify loaded climbing and turning. The advertised 10 kg·cm is unverified.

source_column_2: Metal gearmotor mounting brackets with fasteners; match the selected motor’s nominal 37 mm body, mounting holes and permitted screw depth
source_column_6: Secures four motors, with one spare bracket. Confirm dimensions after the motor is accepted; avoid imposing suspension loads on the motor housing.

source_column_2: Team-made wheel/tyre and cover printing material: 2 kg TPU 95A plus 1 kg PETG; four custom wheel assemblies, provisionally 215 mm outer diameter
source_column_6: Team designs and manufactures rims and tyres. Stock also covers guards/body pieces. Final width, offset, print mass and structural strength require validation; material allowance, not four purchased RC wheels.

source_column_2: New Rain brushed ESC, team-selected 80 A / 480 A-burst-labelled family (previous Model 4438); exact supplied variant must support 3S LiPo at 12.6 V, proportional forward/reverse and suitable LiPo cutoff
source_column_6: Two installed: one per side, each feeding two parallel motors; one spare. Retained BDT 1,850 each estimate. Verify real current rating, reverse/brake mode and BEC. Use supplied receiver leads; power receiver from ONE verified 5 V BEC only.

source_column_2: FlySky FS-i6X transmitter with FS-iA10B receiver; AFHDS 2A, with two independent centred PWM control channels
source_column_6: Commercial drive control. Program transmitter mixing for left/right ESC commands; no separate mixer board. Set both ESC-channel failsafes to calibrated neutral. Disconnect/insulate the unused ESC BEC positive wire; retain both signals and grounds.

source_column_2: AA 1.5 V alkaline transmitter batteries, matched sets; confirm the supplied transmitter battery compartment
source_column_6: Four cells power the handheld transmitter; four are an optional spare set. BDT 50 each. All eight are included in this budget. The rover battery does not power the handheld transmitter.

source_column_2: OPTIONAL receiver-backup buck kit: LM2596-based adjustable module, preset 5.0 V and load-tested at 0.5 A; covered 1 A input fuse/holder, leads and insulated mounting
source_column_6: Spare for receiver power only; included in total. Normally use one ESC BEC. If this backup is fitted, disconnect both ESC BEC positive wires and retain signal grounds. Never use this module to power the task Raspberry Pi.

source_column_2: Gens Ace 3S LiPo drive battery, 11.1 V nominal, 5000 mAh, 60C, XT60 main connector and 4-pin JST-XH balance lead; verify exact supplied model
source_column_6: One drive pack installed at a time; second is a spare, not connected in parallel. 12.6 V full charge and 55.5 Wh nominal per pack. Runtime needs measurement; separate from the 2200 mAh task pack.

source_column_2: 2S–6S LiPo balance charger, at least 50 W output, balance/storage modes; 100–240 V AC 50/60 Hz supply, Bangladesh/US mains leads or adapter, XT60 and 3S JST-XH charging leads
source_column_6: Shared charger for drive/task packs, charged separately. Revised allowance; verify specifications. Set 3S LiPo; start at 3 A for the drive pack within charger/pack limits. Count this charging kit once when merging budgets.

source_column_2: LiPo charging/storage bag sized for the supplied battery packs
source_column_6: Shared ground-support item already referenced in the Tasks list; buy once. Use for supervised charging/storage as specified by the battery supplier, not as the rover’s structural battery enclosure.

source_column_2: Adjustable per-cell LiPo alarm/tester compatible with 3S JST-XH; individual-cell voltage display and audible warning
source_column_6: Drive-pack cell warning, additional to the task-pack alarm. Set approximately 3.6 V/cell per pack guidance; stop on warning and unplug after use. This alarm does not replace verification of the New Rain ESC’s LiPo cutoff.

source_column_2: Drive main fuse kit: covered holder and three 20 A fuses rated at least 32 V DC; one fitted and two spares
source_column_6: Main short-circuit protection close to battery positive. Confirm the provisional 20 A rating with combined starting current, wire ampacity and the selected ESCs before installation. Price includes two spare fuses.

source_column_2: Individual motor branch fuse kit: four covered holders and eight 5 A time-delay fuses rated at least 32 V DC; four fitted and four spares
source_column_6: One fitted fuse in either lead of each motor; four spare fuses included. Both motor terminals remain connected to their ESC output pair. Ratings are provisional; these fuses do not establish motor thermal protection.

source_column_2: Drive DC master disconnect switch with secure mounting; verified rating at least 50 A continuous at 16 V DC
source_column_6: One accessible switch after the main fuse; one spare. Isolates the drive battery for servicing. Stop normally before disconnecting; do not assume an unpowered rover will hold position on a slope.

source_column_2: Silicone-insulated copper power wiring kit: short 12 AWG battery/distribution feed, 14 AWG feeds to two ESCs and 16 AWG individual motor branches
source_column_6: Connects the fused drive battery to both ESCs and four motors. Verify lengths, ampacity and voltage drop. Twist motor pairs; neither motor terminal connects directly to ground. Both ESC battery inputs share the drive pack.

source_column_2: Drive connector kit: XT60 mating connectors, covered distribution terminals, correctly sized ferrules/ring terminals, heat-shrink, cable ties and strain relief
source_column_6: Retained, insulated battery/fuse/switch/ESC joints. Match connectors to conductor size/current. Keep task and drive power separate. Includes spare terminals and heat-shrink; use supplied ESC receiver leads without another cable purchase.

source_column_2: 100 nF, at least 50 V ceramic motor-suppression capacitors
source_column_6: One directly across each of the six purchased motors’ terminals; six spare capacitors. Helps reduce brush noise. Keep power leads away from the task radio antenna and receiver.

source_column_2: Separate electrically insulated drive-battery enclosure with retaining strap, cushioning, protected cable exit and secure chassis mounting
source_column_6: One installed enclosure and one replacement kit, matched to the 5000 mAh pack. Keep the battery separate from other components; the task battery has its own enclosure.

source_column_2: Splash-resistant, ventilated drive-control enclosure kit: insulating standoffs, ESC mounting pads, cable glands, antenna supports and retained wiring
source_column_6: Protects the two ESCs and receiver while allowing cooling. Keep antennas clear of metal/high-current wiring. Validate ESC temperature under load. No additional fan is budgeted without a demonstrated cooling need.

source_column_2: Transmitter/ESC configuration and pre-run checks; existing radio controls and workshop equipment; no additional computer controller
source_column_6: Configure and test radio mixing, each ESC’s neutral/endpoints, proportional reverse, braking, link-loss stop and 3S cutoff. Verify loaded turning, speed ≤8 km/h, stopping and runtime. Do not assume static hill holding. Team setup labour excluded.

source_column_2: TOTAL INCLUDING SPARES AND OPTIONAL ITEMS
source_column_6: Includes all listed spares/options. Estimates exclude shipping, taxes and labour. Shared charging equipment counted once. USD total converted before rounding.
